q.line: Ah, the lengthening hours and the refinery
stanza: Ah, the lengthening hours and the refinery
We do our best vampire routines
As we suck the dying hours dry
The night is lovely as a rose
If I see sunlight hit you, I am sure that we'll both decompose

q.line: Since when was this a winery?
stanza: It don't feel like home no more
Since when was this a winery?
It used to be the bingo
I've walked these streets for all my life
They know me like no other
I no longer feel them shudder

partner.line: I've walked these streets for all my life
